name: tastecode-v0.5-launch-film
description: The TasteCode v0.5 launch film, built in Remotion: one beat-locked timeline drives picture, text and sound.

scripts.stills: remotion still TextLabFidelity out/stills/text-lab-fidelity.png --log=error && remotion still StyleMarkGlass out/stills/mark-glass.png --log=error && remotion still StyleMarkMetal out/stills/mark-metal.png --log=error
scripts.qa: mkdir -p out/qa && python3 scripts/probe.py out/film.mp4 --spec 1920x1080@60 && python3 scripts/forensics.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --json out/qa/forensics.json && python3 scripts/av-audit.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --stems out/stems --json out/qa/av.json && python3 scripts/sheet.py out/film.mp4 --out out/qa/sheet.png
